question: According to the Census of India 2011, which state has the highest sex ratio?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Census of India 2011**, **Kerala** has the highest **sex ratio** in India, with a figure of **1084 females per 1000 males**.
 
• The **sex ratio** is an important demographic indicator used to measure the number of females per 1000 males in a population.
 
• **Kerala's high sex ratio** reflects its focus on social welfare, education, and healthcare, which contribute to a better position for women.
 
• The state has also been a leader in achieving higher levels of **literacy and gender equality**, which positively impact the sex ratio.
 
• In comparison to the national average sex ratio of **940 females per 1000 males**, Kerala stands out for its progressive social and health policies.
 
• Kerala's achievements in this area are often cited as examples for other states to follow in improving gender-based indicators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Andhra Pradesh**__

 __
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** had a sex ratio of **993 females per 1000 males** as per the Census of India 2011.
 
• The state's sex ratio is close to the national average but lower than states like Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
 
• Andhra Pradesh has implemented several social welfare programs, but challenges such as gender-based disparity still exist.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka**__
 __
 
• **Karnataka** recorded a sex ratio of **973 females per 1000 males** according to the Census 2011.
 
• The state has made progress in areas like education and healthcare, but the sex ratio remains below the national average.
 
• Efforts to improve gender equality are being undertaken in the state.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu** had a sex ratio of **996 females per 1000 males** as per Census 2011.
 
• It is one of the better-performing states in terms of sex ratio, reflecting its focus on social development and gender equality.
 
• The state has robust systems in place for improving healthcare and addressing gender disparities.
